CardDeck.description: The only OpenUI root. Lays out GeneratedCard peers as a horizontal snap deck in narrow containers and a responsive grid in wide containers.

GeneratedCard.signature: GeneratedCard(cardId: string, title: string, children: any[], variant?: "standard" | "hero" | "editorial" | "comparison" | "timeline" | "data" | "action" | "media", density?: "compact" | "balanced" | "immersive", subtitle?: string)
GeneratedCard.description: One peer card in a CardDeck. The host supplies cardId and title; compose its children freely without adding another card boundary.

TextContent.description: Text block. Supports markdown. Optional size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy".

MarkDownRenderer.description: Renders markdown text with optional container variant

Stack.signature: Stack(children: any[], direction?: "row" | "column", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "2xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" | "baseline", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around" | "evenly", wrap?: boolean)
Stack.description: Flex container. direction: "row"|"column" (default "column"). gap: "none"|"xs"|"s"|"m"|"l"|"xl"|"2xl" (default "m"). align: "start"|"center"|"end"|"stretch"|"baseline". justify: "start"|"center"|"end"|"between"|"around"|"evenly".

Card.signature: Card(children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | Steps | Tabs | Carousel | Stack)[], variant?: "card" | "sunk" | "clear", direction?: "row" | "column", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "2xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" | "baseline", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around" | "evenly", wrap?: boolean)
Card.description: Styled container. variant: "card" (default, elevated) | "sunk" (recessed) | "clear" (transparent). Always full width. Accepts all Stack flex params (default: direction "column"). Cards flex to share space in row/wrap layouts.

CardHeader.description: Header with optional title and subtitle

Callout.signature: Callout(variant: "info" | "warning" | "error" | "success" | "neutral", title: string, description: string, visible?: $binding<boolean>)
Callout.description: Callout banner. Optional visible is a reactive $boolean — auto-dismisses after 3s by setting $visible to false.

TextCallout.description: Text callout with variant, title, and description

TagBlock.description: tags is an array of strings

Table.description: Data table — column-oriented. Each Col holds its own data array.

Col.description: Column definition — holds label + data array

MetricRow.signature: MetricRow(items: {label: string, value: string, detail?: string}[])
MetricRow.description: A compact row of key metrics. Prefer this over manually stacking labels and values.

BarChart.signature: BarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "grouped" | "stacked", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
BarChart.description: Vertical bars; use for comparing values across categories with one or more series

LineChart.signature: LineChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "linear" | "natural" | "step", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
LineChart.description: Lines over categories; use for trends and continuous data over time

AreaChart.signature: AreaChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "linear" | "natural" | "step", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
AreaChart.description: Filled area under lines; use for cumulative totals or volume trends over time

PieChart.signature: PieChart(labels: string[], values: number[], variant?: "pie" | "donut", appearance?: "circular" | "semiCircular")
PieChart.description: Circular slices; use plucked arrays: PieChart(data.categories, data.values)

RadarChart.description: Spider/web chart; use for comparing multiple variables across one or more entities

Slice.description: One slice with label and numeric value

StepsItem.description: title and details text for one step

Timeline.signature: Timeline(items: {title: string, detail?: string, meta?: string}[])
Timeline.description: A chronological or sequential set of milestones with optional detail and metadata.

TabItem.signature: TabItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | Steps)[])
TabItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is tab label, content is array of components

AccordionItem.signature: AccordionItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | Steps)[])
AccordionItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is section title

Carousel.signature: Carousel(children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | Steps)[][], variant?: "card" | "sunk")

RecommendationGrid.signature: RecommendationGrid(items: {title: string, detail?: string, badge?: string, assetRef?: string}[])
RecommendationGrid.description: A scan-friendly grid of recommendations. assetRef is an optional host-owned asset ID, never a URL.

ComparisonGrid.signature: ComparisonGrid(columns: {title: string, rows: {label: string, value: string}[], badge?: string}[])
ComparisonGrid.description: Side-by-side option columns with consistently labeled comparison rows.

MediaHero.signature: MediaHero(title: string, subtitle?: string, assetRef?: string, badges?: string[])
MediaHero.description: A prominent editorial hero with an optional host-owned assetRef. Never pass a URL.

AssetImage.description: Displays a host-resolved image by assetRef. assetRef must come from availableAssets; never pass a URL.

AssetGallery.description: Displays host-resolved image IDs as a two- or three-column gallery. Never pass URLs.

ActionPanel.signature: ActionPanel(title?: string, description?: string, actions: (HostActionChip | HostActionItem)[])
ActionPanel.description: A focused host-action region. Its children must be supplied HostActionChip or HostActionItem refs.

HostActionChip.description: Compact host-side action affordance. actionRef must be copied exactly from CardPlan Markdown.

HostActionItem.signature: HostActionItem(label: string, actionRef: string, description?: string)
HostActionItem.description: A host-side action rendered as a descriptive list or menu row.

HostActionMenu.description: Groups HostActionItem rows as a compact more-actions menu surface.

HostActionList.description: Groups HostActionItem rows as a visible action list.

MediaActionTile.signature: MediaActionTile(title: string, actionRef: string, kicker?: string)
MediaActionTile.description: A visually prominent host-side action tile. It is decorative until the later asset registry adds controlled images.

componentGroups.name: Prompt Capability Palette
notes: GeneratedCard is the only peer-card boundary.
Raw URLs and external tool calls are forbidden.
